line = input()
n = int(line.strip())

matrix = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
sumResult = 0
MOD = 1000000007

for i in range(n + 1):
    matrix[i][0] = 1
    if (i + 0) % 2 == 1:
        sumResult = (sumResult + matrix[i][0]) % MOD

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    for j in range(i, n + 1):
        matrix[j][i] = (matrix[j][i - 1] + matrix[j - 1][i]) % MOD
        if (i + j) % 2 == 1:
            sumResult = (sumResult + matrix[j][i]) % MOD

print(sumResult)
